svg.text: Every one of the 100 rows carries a grounded, one line reason, built only from the candidate's own fields
"Senior Machine Learning Engineer with 6.1 yrs; career history shows BM25, FAISS, HNSW;
8 trust verified skills (Elasticsearch, Machine Learning, Information Retrieval);

g.text: Specific facts: years, named skills, and signal values, never generic praise.
JD connection: the evidence cited (BM25, FAISS) maps to the JD's hard requirements.
No hallucination by construction: terms are drawn from the career history only, so the reason can never claim a skill the profile lacks.
Honest concerns surfaced: gaps, long notice periods, or low activity are stated plainly, and the tone matches the rank.

svg.text: word boundary matching (no false skills), trust weighted skills defeat keyword stuffing, honeypots (impossible profiles) detected and excluded, robust to missing fields
